Multi-Channel Mastery: Orchestrate a modern sequence of touchpoints across LinkedIn, email, and phone, while engaging authentically in developer-centric spaces.
Market Intelligence: Act as a critical feedback loop for Product and Marketing by capturing the "voice of the prospect" and identifying emerging pain points in the AI and MLOps landscape.
Process Innovation: Partner with Sales Ops to constantly refine our tech stack (HubSpot, Salesforce, Clay) and experiment with new ways to automate the mundane so you can focus on the meaningful.

s.h: This role could be a fit for you if you bring
s.t:
Experience: 1–3 years of experience in sales, lead generation, or a high-intensity customer-facing role, preferably within the DevOps, Cloud, or SaaS space.
Technical Curiosity: You don’t need to be an engineer, but you must be "K8s-curious." You are excited to learn the difference between a pod and a virtual cluster so you can speak with authority.
Grit & Ownership: You thrive in an early-stage environment where the playbook is still being written. You take extreme ownership of your targets and drive outcomes without needing a script.
Communication Clarity: You have a gift for distilling complex infrastructure concepts into clear, high-impact messages that spark curiosity in highly technical buyers.
AI-Native Workflow: You naturally use AI tools to research prospects, personalize outreach at scale, and streamline your daily workflow to stay ahead of the curve.
Cognitive Flexibility: You view "no" as data. You are quick to pivot your strategy based on feedback and market signals.

Ecosystem Familiarity: Prior exposure to the CNCF landscape, Managed Kubernetes (EKS/GKE/AKS), or the AI/ML stack.
Social Selling: A demonstrated ability to build professional rapport and authority on LinkedIn or within technical communities.
Founding Mentality: A desire to grow into a closer (AE) or a leadership role as we scale through our next phase of growth.
About vCluster Labs
We are a venture-backed tech startup and the company pioneering Kubernetes virtualization for the AI era. We raised +$30M from top-tier VCs such as Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, Doordash) and are in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to complement our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe and we have a remote-first work culture.
We are the leading platform for operating GPU infrastructure, enabling AI Cloud providers to deliver a hyperscaler-like experience to their customers and AI factories that need to build that same experience for their internal teams.

Our platform delivers the full operational stack operators need to run their GPU data centers — managed Kubernetes, fast isolated tenant provisioning, and automated node provisioning and lifecycle management — enabling them to accelerate time to value, reduce operational burden, and maximize the ROI of every GPU.
We're the company behind vCluster, an open-source technology for virtualizing Kubernetes (10k+ GitHub stars, 40M+ virtual clusters created since 2021). Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI — a Kubernetes-native framework purpose-built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Competitive Salary : We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.
Platinum-Level Insurance : Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).
Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.
Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.
Culture & Values

s.h: At vCluster Labs , we value and stand for
s.t:
Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.
Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.
Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.
Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.
Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

M. Dodaj, comment s'est déroulé votre premier rendez-vous ce matin ?
Ma matinée s'est très bien passée. Le premier rendez-vous consistait à présenter le SIBIR à un important propriétaire immobilier. Ce fut une rencontre agréable, au cours de laquelle j'ai réussi à susciter l'intérêt du propriétaire pour SIBIR et à le convaincre de notre offre.
Quel rôle jouez-vous en tant que responsable régional des ventes chez SIBIR ?
En tant que responsable régional des ventes, je suis chargé de l'accompagnement complet et du soutien des clients professionnels et privés dans la région de Zurich et de la Suisse centrale.

Mon domaine de responsabilité ne se limite pas seulement à l'entretien des relations clients existantes, mais inclut également la tâche cruciale d'acquérir de nouveaux clients dans ma zone de compétence.

Cette double mission exige une approche globale afin de garantir que tant les clients actuels que potentiels bénéficient du meilleur service et conseil possible.
Avec quels départements travaillez-vous particulièrement en étroite collaboration ?
Dans mon travail quotidien, je collabore étroitement avec la planification du service et le service commercial interne. L'échange régulier avec ces départements est essentiel pour assurer un traitement sans accroc.

Tant dans la planification que dans le service commercial interne, des collègues expérimentés et professionnels travaillent ensemble pour offrir un service optimal à nos clients et répondre au mieux à leurs besoins spécifiques.

Cette coopération étroite permet une coordination efficace des processus et garantit que nous pouvons répondre de manière flexible aux besoins de nos clients.
Quelles tendances observez-vous dans les produits SIBIR ?
Les produits SIBIR mettent clairement en avant les tendances de la Swissness, de l'élégance ainsi que d'un design simple et épuré. Ces éléments représentent une promesse de qualité. La focalisation sur la simplicité et l'épuration souligne non seulement la convivialité des produits, mais reflète également un design intemporel.

Ces tendances visent à garantir que les produits SIBIR ne soient pas seulement fonctionnels, mais aussi esthétiquement attrayants et en accord avec les normes élevées de la tradition de fabrication suisse.
Et dans le domaine du service toutes marques ?
Dans l'évolution actuelle du service toutes marques, des tendances claires se dégagent. Un souhait croissant des clients est de recevoir tous les services regroupés et fournis par un seul interlocuteur. La nécessité d'avoir un point de contact unique pour divers besoins prend de plus en plus d'importance.

Il est notable que le prix n'est souvent plus au centre des préoccupations. Les clients accordent plutôt une importance accrue à un traitement professionnel et efficace de leurs demandes, ce qui est considéré comme une valeur ajoutée.

Cela illustre un déplacement des considérations purement financières vers un accent renforcé sur la qualité globale du service et la simplicité du traitement.
Comment percevez-vous vos clients, qu'ils soient administrations ou particuliers ?
Mes expériences avec mes clients, qu'il s'agisse d'administrations ou de particuliers, sont globalement positives. Je suis heureux de pouvoir dire que j'entretiens des relations très agréables avec nos clients chez SIBIR.

La collaboration avec les administrations et les particuliers se déroule de manière positive, et j'apprécie la possibilité de contribuer à leur satisfaction. Je me réjouis de continuer à soutenir nos clients avec enthousiasme à l'avenir et de poursuivre ces expériences positives de collaboration.
Cela nécessite certainement des mesures de vente individuelles. Les développez-vous seul ?
Nous disposons de cadres très expérimentés qui nous soutiennent à un niveau élevé. Lors du développement des mesures de vente, il est toutefois important de noter que chaque client a des besoins différents. Il est donc indispensable d'être flexible et d'utiliser les mesures de vente appropriées au bon moment. Cela exige de chaque membre de l'équipe de la sensibilité et de la flexibilité.
Concernant la durabilité : comment pourrait-on économiser davantage de CO2 ?
Spécialement dans le contexte des appareils ménagers, je souhaite souligner les points suivants : prolongation de la durée de vie des appareils : la garantie des pièces détachées de SIBIR suit déjà une voie très positive avec nos clients. Pas moins de 70 % de tous les appareils sont réparés et non remplacés.

En favorisant une durée de vie plus longue et en garantissant la disponibilité des pièces détachées, nous contribuons activement à réduire l'empreinte écologique et à minimiser les émissions de CO2.

Ces approches durables sont non seulement en accord avec les objectifs environnementaux, mais démontrent également notre engagement commun pour un avenir respectueux des ressources.
La réparation des machines cassées a-t-elle aujourd'hui une plus grande importance ?
Absolument. Cette évolution est perceptible pour moi personnellement et je la perçois de manière positive. Une tendance claire se manifeste dans la préférence de nos clients pour les réparations plutôt que pour l'achat immédiat d'un nouvel appareil.

Cela souligne non seulement une conscience environnementale accrue, mais reflète également une valorisation croissante des pratiques durables. L'importance accrue accordée à la réparation des machines cassées se reflète donc non seulement dans ma perception personnelle, mais est également clairement soulignée par les préférences de notre clientèle.
Quel était votre métier de rêve enfant ?
Enfant, mon métier de rêve était policier. Mais au fil du temps, j'ai développé un fort intérêt pour une activité dans la vente. J'ai finalement pu réaliser ce rêve chez SIBIR.

This isn't an SDR role. It's an apprenticeship designed to turn you into an elite seller.

9 months: Verticals producing consistent pipeline, leading full discovery independently, closing smaller deals.
12 months: Promotion-ready with proven ability to generate pipeline and close deals.

Technical enough. You don't need to code, but you need to understand how AI and computer vision solve real business problems.

Scope automates the data collection that’s slowing down the physical world.
We’re building the best AI-native data collection layer for the 2 billion field workers on the front line of inspection. Along the way, we’re building the world’s largest dataset on the condition of the built world and the decisions experts make about it.
It’s a $2T market and we’re just getting started. We have grown revenue 1 0x in the last year and on track to reach 10M ARR in 2026 . Our customers inspect facilities and products for companies including AstraZeneca and SpaceX .
We’ve assembled a best-in-class team : people from institutions like Imperial, Carnegie Mellon and Oxford, and from firms like Goldman Sachs, Flexport and Amazon.
Since launching from Entrepreneurs First in 2024, we've raised an oversubscribed $20m round led by Index Ventures , the firm behind Figma, Revolut and Wiz, with over 100 unicorns backed to date.
We are looking for an ENT Sales Executive who is entrepreneurial and a commercial powerhouse ready to lead our revenue growth from the front lines.
You’ve already proven you can sell somewhere else and you’ve hit or beaten quota, and you know how to run a deal end to end. Now you want more than the next quota. You want to build the system, not just work inside one someone else built. This is a role for someone who wants to take the next step in their career who’s hungry to own pre-sales and post-sales, not just the close.
If you’re energised by high velocity, deep customer relationships, and the chance to build something from nothing in a massive legacy market, this will be a career-defining role.

Own the full sales lifecycle : Manage the entire funnel from initial discovery and platform deep-dives to commercial negotiation and closing five- and six-figure ARR deals.
Build what happens after the deal closes : Set up onboarding and customer success frameworks from scratch, so early customers get value fast and become references for the next deal.
Master the TIC domain : Become an absolute expert on our product and the workflows of our customers (lab managers, compliance directors, and operations executives). You won’t rely on a carousel of sales engineers, you will be the trusted advisor.
Navigate high stakes £100k+ ARR cycles : Lead complex, multi-month enterprise sales cycles with global TIC organisations, confidently navigating multi stakeholder buying committees, rigorous governance/security reviews, and legal bottlenecks to close seven figure, transformational deals.
Shape the GTM playbook : Work closely with our Founders, Product, and Marketing teams to test new messaging, refine our outbound strategies, and relay direct market feedback to help steer the product roadmap.
Wear multiple hats : In an early-stage startup, "that's not my job" doesn't exist. You’ll occasionally step up to support onboarding, attend industry events, or jump into whatever the week needs.

We don’t care about a perfect, check-box resume. We care about hunger, sales instinct, and the drive to build something that doesn’t exist yet. You’ll be a fantastic fit if:
You’ve already proven you can sell: 3–6 years of experience in a fast-paced B2B software sales or comparable commercial role (e.g. enterprise SaaS, top-tier consulting, or tech-forward industrial sales), with a track record of beating quota.
You’ve outgrown your current setup: You’ve hit a ceiling and there is too much structure, not enough ownership, a playbook you didn’t write and can’t change and you’re ready to build one from scratch instead.
You love the weeds and the big picture: You can zoom in to understand a granular, technical workflow for a testing lab, and zoom out to negotiate a strategic contract with an executive.
You are comfortable with ambiguity: We have product-market fit, but we are still building the machine. You don't need a fully-baked playbook; you are excited to build it as you go.

Our benefits are designed to reflect our values. We offer comprehensive employee benefits, which includes the following:
Highly competitive base and significant equity so you have a stake in what you are building
We provide full visa sponsorship that has allowed us to have unrestricted access to global talent and build an international, diverse team
Tools to do your job including brand new MacBook laptop + Scope merch
Generous above-market annual leave allowance
Full Medical, Dental coverage with Bupa
Employee Pension through NEST
Flexible Parental Leave (including Adoption Leave)
Healthy meal prep delivered Lunch and Dinners as well as fully stocked fridge and snacks, drinks
Team lunches on Fridays
Regular events including off-sites
Learning and Development: Access to online resources and courses as well as internal Lunch and Learn seminars that allow collaboration and continuous development
At Scope, we believe diverse perspectives build stronger products and teams. Even if your background doesn't perfectly align with every single bullet point here, if you have the drive and the commercial instincts to excel in this role and be a part of a transformational start up, we strongly encourage you to apply.

Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive.
On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach.
We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.
This is a remote position open to candidates based in Germany, France, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara’s mission.
You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

ADR pathways
Through Samsara’s ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers.

With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs’ understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.
ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara.

At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more.

Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.
The next level in the program is ADR II , where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives.

Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives.

After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.
The highest level within our organization is ADR III . These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos.

Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.
Total Rewards
At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders.

Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company.

Quartzy is the world’s #1 lab management platform, trusted by hundreds of thousands of scientists worldwide. By combining SaaS and eCommerce in a unique business model loved by customers, we help researchers spend less time on logistics and more time on discovery.

From cancer research and climate change to winemaking and vegan cheese, our impact is broad and meaningful. You’ll have the flexibility of remote work, the security of a profitable business, and the purpose of contributing to discoveries that matter. At Quartzy, your work has impact—on your life, your career, and on science worldwide.

3. Cross-functional Collaboration
· Partner with Marketing on campaigns that support both SaaS and e-commerce.
· Coordinate with Supply, Software, Pricing, Customer Success, and Operations to relay field insights and strengthen company across the board.

About ISSA : ISSA is an education and certification company for fitness trainers, personal trainers, strength and conditioning coaches, nutritionists, nutrition coaches, yoga instructors, health coaches, medical professionals, and more!

For over 35 years, ISSA has created a personal fitness training program to merge gym experience with practical and applied sciences. With over 250 employees, we have certified nearly 500,000 trainers in 174 countries.

We were recently recognized as a Best Place to Work and Healthiest Employer by The Phoenix Business Journal, Fastest Growing Private Company by Inc. Southwest Regionals, and Top Workplace by USA Today!
We are adding an Inside Sales Representative (Fitness Education Advisor) to our team of relationship-builders who are laser-focused on providing exceptional service to our students. We are tenacious and resilient in pursuing personal and professional success while incorporating fun into every day!
So What's the Job?
We’re looking for competitive, coachable, and high-energy Inside Sales Representatives who thrive in a fast-paced, phone-first environment. You’ll engage with prospective students, uncover their goals, and guide them to the right ISSA program, all while driving toward individual and team performance goals.
At ISSA , you’re not just selling, you’re helping people transform their lives through education. We believe in doing the right thing, growing together, and celebrating the wins that matter.

Make 120–200 outbound calls daily to prospective students from warm and cold lists.
Conduct high-energy phone consultations to identify goals, build rapport, and recommend training programs.
Manage your pipeline through a CRM with disciplined notes, tasks, and follow-ups.
Close sales in a short cycle (same-day to 7 days) using ethical persuasion and student-first judgment.
Consistently meet or exceed monthly enrollment and revenue targets.
Collaborate with peers and leaders to improve scripts, objection handling, and conversion rates.
Represent ISSA ’s mission and brand with integrity and enthusiasm.

1+ years of phone-based inside sales experience in a quota-driven environment.
Demonstrated ability to sustain high activity levels (120–200+ dials per day).
Experience in short-cycle or one-call closes (same day to 7 days).
Comfort working shift-based schedules in a fully remote setup.
Strong verbal communication, active listening, and empathy.
Track record of hitting or exceeding individual sales targets.
Familiarity with CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar).
Continuously identifies opportunities to leverage AI tools for efficiency and innovation.

Experience in B2C or consumer-style B2B sales environments.
Prior success with outbound sales or lead follow-up campaigns.
High energy and resilience in competitive, metrics-driven settings.

s.t:
Prior ISSA certification or wellness industry exposure.
Advanced CRM hygiene and data management habits.

Skills can be developed. Experience can be built. What's harder to teach, and what we pay close attention to, is mindset. The qualifications below are specific to this role. But across every role at ISSA , we're looking for the same kind of person.
Someone who leads with curiosity. Who asks "why do we do it this way?" as a genuine question, not a complaint.
Someone humble enough to know what they don't know, and bold enough to challenge the way things have always been done.
Someone who can advocate hard for an idea and then fully commit when the team goes a different direction.
Someone who takes ownership of their mistakes, shares credit for their wins, and believes the best idea should win regardless of who had it.
We're looking for people who are personally invested in healthy living, not because it's their job, but because they believe in its power to change lives. You don't have to have it all figured out. You just have to care.
We're not looking for perfect. We're looking for growth-oriented, mission-driven, and genuinely invested in doing something that matters. If that sounds like you, you'll fit in great here!

s.h: Anything else? Absolutely! Benefits and Perks
s.t:
This is a place where every day we are inspired by our teammates, encouraging each other to be our best. The environment is friendly and upbeat! And we feel it’s important to reward our team with competitive pay and benefits. Here are some of the highlights:
Free Certifications: Who wants to be their best self? WE DO! As an ISSA team member, you have access to our courses and certifications…at no expense! Additionally, you'll receive exclusive discounts on leading products in the fitness industry. Cool, right? Employees can also enroll up to 5 friends/family members each year in our courses...FOR FREE!
Health & Wellness Reimbursement: If our company’s mission is to encourage healthy living, we need to walk the talk and ensure each employee is supported in their wellness journey! Employees can submit fitness purchases (gym membership, fitness equipment, classes) and professional and mental health purchases (personal learning courses, wellness apps, art classes, and more) for reimbursement up to $50/month…$600/year.
Work-Life Synergy: Our Team members start with 3 weeks of PTO each year and can earn up to 6 weeks each year! And everyone at ISSA gets 9 paid national holidays every year...PLUS 1 floating holiday! Work hard, play hard!
Parental Time Off: We support our team members as they grow their families! Eligible employees giving birth can receive up to 12 weeks of paid leave, while other parents welcoming a new child (including partners and adoptive/foster parents) receive up to 6 weeks of paid bonding leave.
Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance: A key component to living a healthy lifestyle is having access to the care we (and our families) need. We offer 2 medical insurance plans accompanied by Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Savings Account (FSA) options, as well as Dental and Vision coverage. And you don’t have to wait forever! Eligibility begins on the 1st of the month after you start.
Team Building: We may be remote, but we don’t have to be alone! We host a monthly schedule of virtual team activities, town halls, brown bag lunches, and other special events…so many fun ways for us to connect and support one another.
Tools To Do The Job: We ensure you are hooked up with the tools, equipment, and systems you need. We begin the process before your start date, so you are ready to rock ‘n roll on your first day. We also provide a monthly work-from-home allowance!

Chez nous, tu trouveras un environnement où la confiance et les performances vont de pair. Ici, nous comptons sur toi pour nous apporter tes idées, prendre des initiatives et contribuer activement. ## Ce que tu apportes ##
* **Conseiller & accompagner tes client·e·s à long-terme:** Tu accompagnes les client·e·s privé·e·s et entreprises dans toutes leurs questions d'assurance avec un réel engagement et proposes des solutions personnalisées, adaptées à chaque besoin individuel. En tant que conseiller·ère client·e·s, tu es là quand il le faut
* **Créer des relations durables:** La confiance est au centre de ton activité - tu entretiens et développes des relations clients solides, fondées sur un service d'excellence
* **Contribuer activement à la croissance: **Tu possèdes un bon réseau et tu investis dans l'acquisition de nouveaux client·e·s. Ton engagement contribue à l'expansion continue de notre portefeuille. Comment t'y aidons nous ? En te confiant un portefeuille clients, composé de client·e·s privé·e·s et d'entreprises
* **Soutien marketing & vente:** Avec des idées fraîches, tu contribues à nos actions marketing, participes à des salons et à divers événements pour renforcer notre réseau
* **Toujours à la pointe:** Grâce à notre formation de base et à des formations continues, tu restes à jour sur le plan technique et offres un conseil de la plus haute qualité
## Ton profil ##
* **Expérience & expertise:** Tu disposes d'expérience dans le conseil à la clientèle ou dans la vente - idéalement dans la finance ou les assurances. Les personnes en reconversion, motivées et prêtes à apprendre rapidement, sont également les bienvenues
* **Talent de communication:** Tu sais enthousiasmer les gens et les convaincre. Tu te distingues par ta force de communication et de négociation. En tant que conseiller·ère client·e·s, tu sais argumenter avec assurance et disposes d'un excellent niveau de français
* **Le service est ta force:** Le travail en clientèle te passionne ; ton sens du service et ton orientation client sont exemplaires
* **Engagement & esprit d'initiative:** Avec une motivation supérieure à la moyenne et un esprit entrepreneurial affirmé, tu es prêt·e à accomplir de grandes choses et à dépasser les objectifs
* **Ancrage régional:** Tu habites dans région de distribution. Tu disposes d'un solide réseau local et apprécies de créer et d'entretenir de nouveaux contacts

Als Master Planner übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle in der Abstimmung von Kundenbedarfen mit Produktionskapazitäten. Sie sorgen für reibungslose Abläufe, termingerechte Lieferungen und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen. Diese Position bietet eine spannende Mischung aus operativer Planung, Performance-Analyse und strategischer Koordination - ideal für Personen mit Leidenschaft für Supply Chain Management.
**Standort**: Raron (VS)
**Vertragsart**: unbefristet
**Vertragsstart**: per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

* **Erstellung & Pflege des MPS:** Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Aktualisierung des Master Production Schedule unter Berücksichtigung von Kundenbedarf, Kapazitäten und Materialverfügbarkeit sowie Integration ins ERP-System inkl. Einkaufsbedarfen.
* **Kapazitäts- und Machbarkeitsplanung:** Verantwortung für Rough-Cut Capacity Planning (RCCP) im S&OP-Prozess und Sicherstellung, dass der Produktionsplan realistisch und zu 100-% umsetzbar ist.
* **Abteilungsübergreifende Abstimmung:** Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Vertrieb, Einkauf, Produktion und Supply Chain zur Sicherstellung einer integrierten und realistischen Planung.
* **Monitoring & Optimierung:** Analyse von Bedarfs-, Material- und Kapazitätsdaten, Identifikation von Engpässen sowie Einleitung geeigneter Maßnahmen zur Optimierung von Auslastung, Priorisierung und Losgrössen.
* **Prozess-, KPI- und Datenmanagement:** Weiterentwicklung von Planungsprozessen und Tools, Sicherstellung von Datenqualität (BOM, Stammdaten), KPI-Reporting sowie Einhaltung von Lieferterminen und Service-Level-Zielen inklusive EOL-Management
